authority.basis: 2026-09-07 user: 응 그렇게 하고 끝까지 연구목표에 맞게 연구를 실시할수있도록하라.
authority.scope: new local secondary analysis of already exposed public Wearable source39 only; does not reopen or amend retired candidates
authority.shared_manifest_permission: predicate-filter source39 and project acquisition columns before returning rows; shared parquet container reads allowed; no held rows returned or used

impedance_vector_indexing: 64-vector zero-based slots = canonical_channel_ids minus1; IDs are one-based, preserve native channel order
preprocessing: raw crop first; native250Hz; channel-center within crop; fixed7band filter; no resampling,zscore,processed EEG or stored query QC; distributed downsampling is upstream and not revalidated as online-causal

q.input: first filtered band6-90Hz current cropped trial only; no labels,metadata,other query trials or target batch statistics
q.full: symmetric_eigh log(S); support_block_descriptor=mean of12 trial log(S); distance_squared=Frobenius_difference_squared/8
q.interpretation: class-agnostic context proxy, NOT class-independent or noise-only
q.support_reliability: mean labeled-class 5-harmonic projection power / centered raw-window power
q.weights: uniform=1/k; otherwise softmax(log(.05+r_b)-dQ2/(2*tau2)); reliability omits distance; all classes share same current-query block weights

m.input: pre-block per-channel impedance_kohm; same-interface support/query; IDs/order never classifier inputs
m.scale: per-interface/channel IQR of log1p(z) across unique fit participant*10block packets, floor0.1; not class-repeated rows
m.validity: finite z>=0 is valid includingzero; null/NaNmissing; negative/infinite values rejected; nofinitefitvalues gives scale0.1 withfit_available=false andneutralcontribution
m.distance_squared: sum_common_finite_and_fit_available_channels(((log1p(zq)-log1p(zb))/fit_scale)^2)/8; missing channel contribution0; no common channels exact neutral
m.affinity: clip(exp(-beta*dM2/2),.25,1); multiply Q block weights and renormalize across available prefix
m.temperature: exactly the frozen selected AQ temperature; no M-specific fit
m.shuffle: all support-prefix packet derangements,2 at k3/44 at k5; preserve EEG,Q,query packet,availability pairing,temperatures; average metrics not probabilities; k0/k1 exactAQ alias withpermutations0 andnointervention
m.stale: replace query packet by last available support packet; do not fetch future support
m.order_control: multiply Q weights by clip(exp(-beta*((query_block-support_block)/10)^2/2),.25,1); stronger recencygrid spanssame affinityfloor; chronology control not acquisition contribution

decoder.template: query-specific classwise weighted support waveform BEFORE signed filterbank correlation; exact Gram sufficient-statistic implementation allowed
decoder.score: sum_f weight_f*sign(r_f)*r_f^2 / sum_f weight_f; flatten channel/time after per-band vector centering
decoder.degenerate_scores: zero or nonpositive Gramdenominator givescorrelation0; clampcorrelation[-1,1]; logtrueprobability floor1e-300
decoder.A0: public FBCCA squared correlations, original uncentered native raw crop and7band config; support-free score normalized by sum weights
decoder.eTRCA: existing predict_filterbank_ensemble_trca withridge1e-6,k3/k5only,originaluncenteredrawcrop/filterbank; retainpublic unnormalizedweightedscore; k0/k1 unavailable not fabricated

fitting.outer_folds: sorted39 source list position modulo3; each fold fit26 and development-evaluate13
fitting.interpretation: bounded supervised nuisance fitting by NLL then outer cross-fitting; not nested inner-validation, not independent newly recruited cohort
fitting.A0_temperature: one scalar minimizing standalone NLL over all6 cells and fit26 query labels; shared allbudgets
fitting.support_temperatures: one scalar per candidate per budget1/3/5 minimizing actual .5A0+.5support fused NLL over allfit26*6cells; k1 allcandidate exactuniform alias
fitting.q_selection: one candidate minimizing mean fitted fused NLL for k3 andk5; no M or outer-evaluation outcomes; exacttie first declared candidate
fitting.diag_full_diagnostics: best source-NLL candidate among its three declared taus; same tie policy
fitting.m_selection: after AQ frozen, beta minimizes mean actual fused NLL over k3/k5 allfit26*6cells; exacttie beta0
fitting.order_selection: independent beta on declared order_beta_grid minimizing same fit-only objective
fitting.eTRCA_temperatures: one standalone NLL-minimizing temperature per k3/k5 onfit26; probability diagnostic only

reporting.unit: 39 historically exposed participants; equal mean of interfaces/windows within participant; cross-fitted development CIs are descriptive not confirmatory
reporting.primary_development_contrast: eAUC(AQM)-eAUC(AQ) across all6 declaredcells; eAUC=BA0/6+BA1/2+BA3/3; never A0-select evaluationcells
reporting.specificity_screen: M3-order_control3 andM3-M_stale3 acrossall6cells each mean>0 andone_sided95LCB>0; failureblocksREADY anddoesnotestablishimpedancebeyondchronology
reporting.cost_comparison: M3-Q5 at1s averagedrywet withinperson; Q5-Q3 mean>=.01 andLCB>0; M3-Q5 LCB>-1/60; M3 andQ5 meanBA>=.8
reporting.cost_target_interpretation: 80percent is participant/equal-interface populationmean, NOT everyperson oreachinterface; reportinterface-specific BA andattainment withoutsuchguarantee
reporting.classical_screen: M3-FB_eTRCA3 at1s mean>=0 andLCB>-1/60; reporteTRCA3/5; no claim tooutperformunimplemented SOTA
reporting.controls: k0/k1 Mnull,allmissing/zero exactQ; shuffle/stale/order controls; percell/perpersonharm; metadataweights turnover andeffectiveblocks
reporting.attainment: firstobserved k reaching.8 else >5; eTRCA observesonly3/5 anddoesnotimpute0/1; labeledtrials12k,analyzedEEGseconds12k*N/250
reporting.confidence_intervals: Student t df38 on39participant vectors; sampleSD ddof1/sqrt39; one-sided95 uses t.ppf(.95); two-sided95 t.ppf(.975); descriptive cross-fitted dependence not calibratedconfirmatorycoverage
